c74object.name: evi_warmer_lib
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_warmer_lib.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_warmer_lib.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_warmer_lib.genexpr file also requires:
evi_smooth.genexpr
evi_rcfilters.genexpr
evi_butterworth.genexpr
About this File:
This file is mainly here as a catch all for the require files it inherits for building the evieve [evi.warmer~] abstraction. It also contains core functions for that abstraction.

entry.name: D ( )
entry.description:
Helper function, return 'sqrt(x * sign(x)'
In 1: type=input: x, X
Return 1: Y, sqrt(x * sign(x)

entry.name: szilagyi ( )
entry.description:
Tom Szilagyi's original coefficients calculator for the saturator
In 1: type=input: drive, Drive amount 0.1..10
In 2: type=input: blend, Blend amount -10..10
In 3: type=input: sr, Pass in samplerate
Return 1: srct, Coefficient 1
Return 2: ap, Coefficient 2
Return 3: kpa, Coefficient 3
Return 4: kpb, Coefficient 4
Return 5: an, Coefficient 5
Return 6: kna, Coefficient 6
Return 7: knb, Coefficient 7
Return 8: pwrq, Coefficient 8
